en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's clean up a little
Let's read a book on conspiracy theories
Let's make a tower of books

Leave it to me!
I'm really good at cleaning!
I've cleaned up a loooot of things before.
Like enemy organizations and cops...

Oh yeah, I also took on the entire
country before, too...
Well, that's a lie.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Is he lying about lying?

I can't believe you would be into a
book like this.

An advisor who controls politics from behind
the scenes, or an organization full of criminals...

There's no way any of that is real.
Don't waste my time with silly lies.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
You're still a child, Shuichi.
But I don't *dislike* that!

From a social standpoint, making a tower out
of books at our age is pretty embarrassing...

The idea of it doesn't make any
sense either...

But our childish side is something we
should never lose.
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
